title: Beyond Local Accuracy: A Protocol-Level Identifiability Audit for Controlled LLM Reasoning Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.13326v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM benchmark scores can be precise even when the observation protocol does not identify the behavioral property they are intended to measure. In a controlled, solver-grounded setting, we formalize a protocol-level identifiability audit over a finite behavioral policy class: given policies H, observation support O, and estimand $\tau$, we test whether O separates every pair with different $\tau$. The audit requires zero model calls and resolves our diagnostic case: base-only observation collapses seven frozen deterministic policies into one equivalence class; full support yields seven classes and no cross-estimand collisions; every leave-one-out support retains a constructive collision witness. translated_title: 超越局部准确性：受控LLM推理评估的协议级可辨识性审计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13326v1 公告类型：新 摘要：即使观察协议无法识别其旨在测量的行为属性，LLM基准分数也可能精确。在受控、基于求解器的环境中，我们在有限行为策略类别上形式化了一种协议级可辨识性审计：给定策略H、观察支持O和估计目标τ，我们测试O是否能区分每一对具有不同τ的样本。该审计不需要任何模型调用，并解决了我们的诊断案例：仅基座观察将七个冻结确定性策略折叠为一个等价类；完整支持产生七个类别且无跨估计目标碰撞；每个留一法支持都保留了一个建设性碰撞见证。实验上，两种受约束生成变体的成对有效性均为1.0，但基座准确性和选择性响应保真度存在分歧——在六个平衡的预言机转换方向上为0.620对0.324（聚类自助法95%置信区间[0.600, 0.642]对[0.600, 0.642]）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种零模型调用的协议级可辨识性审计方法，用于检测受控LLM推理评估中观察协议是否混淆了不同行为属性，并实证揭示了基座准确性指标与选择性响应保真度之间的显著分歧。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a zero-model-call protocol-level identifiability audit to detect whether observation protocols conflate distinct behavioral properties in controlled LLM reasoning evaluation, empirically revealing significant divergence between base accuracy and selective-response fidelity metrics.
